column1: # WHY IT MATTERS HERE, and it is not a curiosity:
# a national AI policy was withdrawn because its citations were AI-generated and did not resolve.
# That is precisely the failure mode these shelves spend every pass defending against, and it is
# the strongest external argument yet for the KB's own first-hand-read rule and for ACTION QO.
# The date divergence is itself the lesson in miniature: two sources, one event, two dates, and
# the honest published state is BOTH with their provenance, not an average and not a coin toss.
